# Medomicile

> Medomicile provides local healthcare guidance, home consultations and emergency orientation in Kenitra, Mehdia and the surrounding area in Morocco.

## Main services

- [Home](https://medomicile.com/): local healthcare access and orientation.
- [Home consultation](https://medomicile.com/consultation.html): request a medical consultation at home in Kenitra and nearby areas.
- [Emergencies](https://medomicile.com/urgences.html): guidance for urgent situations and the public emergency number 15.
- [Emergency facilities](https://medomicile.com/etablissements-urgences.html): hospitals and clinics receiving emergency cases in Kenitra.
- [On-call pharmacies](https://medomicile.com/pharmacies-garde.html): current on-call pharmacy information when data is available.

## Important safety note

Medomicile information does not replace public emergency services. For a life-threatening emergency in Morocco, call 15 immediately.
